MainWindow::onNewFile.state: Creates blank PDF in QDir::temp() via Document::createBlank(); routes through openFile() so all open-file state machinery runs.
MainWindow::onNewFile.visible: Window title updates to 'pdfe_untitled_<ms>.pdf', canvas renders blank page, status bar shows page count, dirty marker absent.
MainWindow::onNewFile.errors: Document::createBlank throws → QMessageBox::critical 'Failed to create blank PDF'; subsequent openFile() failure surfaces its own messaging.

MainWindow::onOpenFile.input: QFileDialog filter 'PDF Files (*.pdf);;All Files (*)' starting from AppSettings::lastOpenDirectory().
MainWindow::onOpenFile.state: Calls openFile(fileName) — closes existing doc, opens new pdfe::core::Document, replaces tileCache_/tileRenderer_/annotationManager_/formManager_/etc., enables ~30 actions, records in recentFilesMenu_.
MainWindow::onOpenFile.errors: User cancels file dialog (no-op return); see openFile error paths.

MainWindow::openFile.state: closeDocument() → Document::open up to 4× retry with PasswordDialog → recreate TileCache/TileRenderer/AnnotationManager/FormManager/JavaScriptEngine/RedactionManager/EncryptionManager/SignatureManager/ImageManager/MetadataManager → wire panels → enable saveAction/saveAsAction/closeAction/copyAction/cutAction/pasteAction/selectAllAction/zoom*/print*/form*/page*/encryption*/signature*/image*/metadata*/compliance/preflight/replace/tabOrder/calculationOrder/altText/submitForm/ocr/treAction/accessibilityAction → recentFilesMenu_->addFile() → AppSettings::setLastOpenDirectory.
MainWindow::openFile.visible: Window title shows filename, status bar shows fileName + 1/N + 100%, canvas renders page 1 fitted, page panel populated, bookmark dock shown if outline present, signature dock shown if signatures present.
MainWindow::openFile.errors: Encrypted PDF without password → PasswordDialog (3 retries, then propagate); Document::open throws → QMessageBox::critical 'Failed to open PDF file' + closeDocument() rollback.

MainWindow::onSaveFile.state: BookmarkPanel::commitToDocument → Document::save(currentFileName_) (atomic temp+rename) → flushAlignmentPipelineIfPending if pending → undoManager_->setClean() → onDocumentStructureChanged().
MainWindow::onSaveFile.visible: Window title clears '*' suffix; status bar 'File saved' for 3000 ms.
MainWindow::onSaveFile.errors: Document not PDF → QMessageBox::warning 'Only PDF documents can be saved'; std::exception during save → QMessageBox::critical 'Save Error'.

MainWindow::onSaveAsFile.input: QFileDialog filter 'PDF Files (*.pdf);;All Files (*)' default = currentFileName_.
MainWindow::onSaveAsFile.state: BookmarkPanel::commitToDocument → Document::saveAs(newPath) → flushAlignmentPipelineIfPending if pending → currentFileName_ = newPath → undoManager_->setClean() → updateWindowTitle.
MainWindow::onSaveAsFile.visible: Title updates to new filename, '*' cleared, status bar 'File saved as <name>' for 3000 ms.
MainWindow::onSaveAsFile.errors: User cancels (no-op); non-PDF → warning; save throws → QMessageBox::critical 'Save Error'.

MainWindow::onCloseFile.state: closeDocument() — releases document_, tileCache_, tileRenderer_, annotationManager_, formManager_, jsEngine_, redactionManager_, encryptionManager_, signatureManager_, imageManager_, metadataManager_; clears commandPages_, toolPage_; disables ~30 document-required actions; clears canvas; resets nav history; closes sticky note popup; clears panels.
MainWindow::onCloseFile.visible: Canvas blank, status bar empty, title '<unnamed>', all dock panels emptied.

MainWindow::onCreatePdfFromImages.input: ImageToPdfWizard interactive flow: image files + page-size + DPI + JPEG quality.
MainWindow::onCreatePdfFromImages.state: Wizard returns std::filesystem::path; openFile(out) replaces document_ with the new PDF.
MainWindow::onCreatePdfFromImages.visible: Wizard dialog; on success canvas shows new PDF, recent-files updated.
MainWindow::onCreatePdfFromImages.errors: Wizard cancelled (out.empty(), no-op); openFile errors propagate.

MainWindow::onPreviousView.state: navHistory_.goBack() returns previous page index; canvas->goToPage(); previous/next view actions re-enabled based on history.canGoBack/canGoForward.
MainWindow::onPreviousView.visible: Canvas navigates to previous viewed page; status bar page index updates.

MainWindow::onNextView.visible: Canvas moves to next visited page.

MainWindow::onExportPlainText.state: PlainTextExporter::write(document_, savePath) — pure read; no document mutation.
MainWindow::onExportPlainText.visible: Status bar 'Exported text to <name>' for 3000 ms.
MainWindow::onExportPlainText.errors: User cancel (no-op); writer returns false → QMessageBox::warning 'Could not write file'.

MainWindow::onExit.state: QCoreApplication::quit() via close()/closeEvent flow; closeEvent calls hasUnsavedChanges and may prompt save.

MainWindow::onUndo.state: undoManager_->undo(); if scanned-page image edit on top, restore saved XObject ref via PdfContentWriter::restoreImageXObjectRef + invalidate ImageReplacer cache; canvas->refreshAllPages; onDocumentStructureChanged; updateWindowTitle.
MainWindow::onUndo.visible: Canvas re-renders with the prior state; window title may add/remove '*' depending on whether undo crosses the saveClean barrier.
MainWindow::onUndo.errors: Empty undo stack → undo() is a no-op.
MainWindow::onUndo.visual: DEPENDS — visible effect depends on what's being undone (page rotation visible; metadata edit not visible from canvas).

MainWindow::onRedo.state: undoManager_->redo(); if next entry has image edit, refreshImageForScannedPage(); markPageDirty; canvas->refreshAllPages; onDocumentStructureChanged.

MainWindow::onCopy.visible: Status bar 'Page text copied to clipboard' for 3000 ms; clipboard side-effect not visible in app window.
MainWindow::onCopy.errors: No document/canvas → no-op; empty page text → status bar 'Copy: no text on this page'.

MainWindow::onCut.state: If textEditTool active and has selection: tool->performCut() — pushes EditTextCommand on undoManager + writes to clipboard. Otherwise no-op.
MainWindow::onCut.visible: Status bar 'Text cut to clipboard' (or 'Cut: select text in an editable span first').
MainWindow::onCut.errors: No selection → status bar message only.
MainWindow::onCut.visual: DEPENDS — visible only if cut succeeds (canvas re-renders).

MainWindow::onPaste.state: If textEditTool active: tool->performPaste() — inserts clipboard text into edit buffer.
MainWindow::onPaste.visible: Status bar 'Clipboard text pasted'; canvas re-renders if paste succeeded.
MainWindow::onPaste.errors: No tool active → status bar 'Paste: activate text editing first'.

MainWindow::onSelectAll.visible: Status bar 'All page text selected and copied to clipboard'.
MainWindow::onSelectAll.errors: No document/canvas → no-op; empty page → status bar message.

MainWindow::onFind.visible: Search dock visible + focused; search line edit gets keyboard focus.

MainWindow::onReplace.state: Locates current hit; builds EditTextCommand; undoManager_->execute; advances to next match.

MainWindow::onReplace.errors: Empty find / no current hit → status text only.

MainWindow::onReplaceAll.visible: Canvas re-renders; SearchPanel 'Replaced N match(es)'/'No matches found'.

MainWindow::onPrintPreview.input: N/A — opens preview with PrintRange::AllPages default.

MainWindow::onZoomIn.state: canvas_->zoomIn() — multiplies current zoom by step factor.

MainWindow::onStickyNotePopupContentsCha.visible: Annotation contents updated; window title gets '*'.

MainWindow::showAtlasComparison.state: AtlasComparisonDialog modal — renders both modes side-by-side.

MainWindow::onToggleStickyNotes.visible: Sticky note icons appear/disappear on canvas.

MainWindow::onTogglePrintPrevention.state: Sets print permission flag on document_.
MainWindow::onTogglePrintPrevention.visible: No immediate visible change; affects subsequent print attempts.

MainWindow::onToggleOcrBoxes.visible: Canvas overlays per-character OCR bounding boxes.

MainWindow::onCommentPanelNavigate.visible: Canvas navigates; comment panel selection follows.

MainWindow::onTreRegionSelected.state: regionReconstructor_->analyze; TreEditDialog modal; ReconstructRegionCommand or ImageReplaceCommand depending on user choice; canvas->refreshPage.
MainWindow::onTreRegionSelected.visible: TRE edit dialog modal; on Accept, canvas region re-renders with new text.
MainWindow::onTreRegionSelected.errors: Analysis fail → QMessageBox::warning 'Could not recognize text'; user cancel.

MainWindow::onRedactToolSelected.state: If checked: onAnnotationToolSelected(redactToolAction_); redactionPanelDock_->show(). Else: revert to selectToolAction_.
MainWindow::onRedactToolSelected.visible: Redaction tool active in canvas; redaction panel visible.

MainWindow::onMarkRedaction.state: Sets redactToolAction_ checked + onRedactToolSelected(); marking happens via tool interaction.

MainWindow::onSaveWithEncryption.input: EncryptionDialog modal (algorithm, key length, user/owner passwords, permissions).
MainWindow::onSaveWithEncryption.state: EncryptionManager::saveEncrypted(document_, outputPath, settings) OR removeEncryption if algorithm==None.

MainWindow::onSaveWithEncryption.errors: User cancel either dialog; save throws → QMessageBox::critical 'Encryption Error'.

MainWindow::onDocumentPermissions.state: Reads encryption info; QMessageBox::information with permissions table.

MainWindow::onRemovePassword.errors: User cancel; std::exception → QMessageBox::critical 'Remove Password Error'.

MainWindow::onSignDocument.input: SignDialog modal — pfx path/password, reason, location, appearance flags, TSA, certification.

MainWindow::onSignDocument.errors: User cancel any step; signField throws → QMessageBox::critical 'Signing Error'.

MainWindow::onVerifySignatures.visible: Signature dock shown; QMessageBox::information with summary.
MainWindow::onVerifySignatures.errors: No signatures → 'no signatures' info; verify throws → QMessageBox::critical.

MainWindow::onRequestValidation.input: ValidationCoordinator modal consent dialog (then async network).
MainWindow::onRequestValidation.state: External OCSP/CRL fetch; embedded in /DSS; ValidationCoordinator::completed/cancelled/failed signals.
MainWindow::onRequestValidation.visible: Modal consent dialog; status bar 'Validation data embedded' / 'Validation request cancelled'.
MainWindow::onRequestValidation.errors: Coordinator request() returns false (no consent) → cleanup; failed signal → cleanup.

MainWindow::onImageToolSelected.state: Lazy-creates ImageTool; wires imageSelected/imageDeselected/removeRequested/resizeRequested/rotateRequested/cropRequested signals; setPage; canvas_->setImageTool.
MainWindow::onImageToolSelected.visible: Image tool active; image properties dock shown when selecting image.

MainWindow::onInsertImage.state: InsertImageCommand with default 72,72,400,300 placement and stripExif=true; canvas refresh.

MainWindow::onStripExif.visible: QMessageBox::information 'Stripped metadata from N image(s)' or 'No images found'.

MainWindow::onDocumentMetadata.visible: MetadataDialog modal; window title may gain '*'.

BookmarkPanel::onCreateAtRoot.state: CreateBookmarkCommand at root level; refresh tree.
